`unhinted.ttf` is an original three-glyph test font under this project's MIT OR
Apache-2.0 licenses. Its rectangle, empty glyphs and metrics come from
`tests/unit/font-program-rules.test.py::truetype`. The three empty hint tables
were removed to exercise preparation of an unhinted source. Its head timestamps
are fixed to 3864672000. It contains no third-party font outlines.
